title: Interruptions
description: A plotter drawing on warm paper after Vera Molnar: a square of fifty by fifty short ink lines of one length, each turned by a small random amount about the vertical, with irregular holes where lines were never drawn. Pass the pointer over the sheet and the lines it touches are lifted off, shrinking to nothing; the pen comes back for them one at a time, slowly, until the holes close. Drag across it and the variance rises under the hand, so the order dissolves into chaos, then each line springs back to its place in the drawing.
intent: From Vera Molnar, Interruptions (1968-69), https://www.sothebys.com/en/articles/vera-molnar-the-grande-dame-of-generative-art : one rule and a small variance make a whole drawing. The pointer is the interruption.
